title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 Noether record: Spanish and Japanese through Paper 08 complete
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs expose source-checkable German modern LaTeX, English high-fidelity translations, and current multilingual pilot translations.

Status at a glance. [##########] numbered-paper German/English stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited; [######----] multilingual stream: Paper 01 pilots in Spanish, Japanese, and French, Paper 02 through sections before 7 in Spanish/Japanese, complete Paper 02 in French, and Spanish/Japanese cumulative readers through Paper 08 complete; [##########] source/artifact preservation: TeX, source-scan witnesses, audit notes, glossary deltas, and reusable methodology notes are preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Latest update. Added Papers 07-08 in the Spanish/Japanese multilingual lane, including cumulative TeX/PDF through Paper 08, standalone Paper 07-08 readers, German source and English control excerpts, source-scan witnesses, render checks, glossary deltas, and cumulative methodology/special-character notes.
notes: Latest update extends the Spanish/Japanese multilingual lane through Paper 08 and adds standalone Paper 07-08 readers plus reusable methodology, glossary, special-character, and notation aids for future multilingual Noether translations.
